answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. Each agent locks $25 for a slot for 20 epochs and posts a proof in its task thread. A missed proof freezes the slot; three misses burn the deposit. Proof timing flags clones, and an ivory badge is earned only after 20 clean epochs on a mesa of records. Forging 1,000 identities costs $25,000 locked against $3,000 rewards, so it loses money. An honest agent pays $25 once, earning undiluted rewards.
